name: Genba Diary
description: Genba Diary is a single-column longform landing WordPress theme for construction site-diary apps and crew rollouts. Built around a diagonal-split hero with a slanted photo triptych, a clean anchor menu and a single repeated request button, it presents a six-section daily log, a seven-day pilot, crew use cases and transparent per-site pricing. Five-language compatible, with high-key documentary photography and clean sans typography.
